regime_context: The detector shows a broad but shallow rotation in Canada: 9 of 16 themes are eligible, with Base Metals & Copper and Oil & Gas Producers clustered tightly at the top (margin 0.11) and no one-narrative dominance. The absolute-trend gate has helped historically on this market, but momentum itself is rank-IC ~0, so these are regime/focus reads, not return forecasts.
emerging_watch: Watching Gold Miners (rank 3, score 1.07, eligible) for a durability pick-up: breadth is thin at 0.4 and hurst_tag is mean-revert, so this theme is not yet a confirmed handoff. The watch condition is gold's breadth climbing above 0.5 while its score holds within 0.3 of the current leader.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper sits at rank 1 with the strongest breadth (0.556) among eligible leaders and is not crowded. However, its hurst_tag is 'mean-revert' and durability_bar is mid-range, so the trend-health leg is only moderately supportive. The lean rests on eligible leadership plus non-crowded texture, which is attention, not alpha.
theses.dissent: Copper's mean-revert signature means the recent strength could be a sharp, short-lived commodity bounce that unwinds quickly; leadership alone has no forward return edge in this market.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO breaks below its 50-day moving average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is a close challenger (score 1.545, margin just 0.11) with the highest breadth among the top three (0.571) and a mixed hurst_tag. It is eligible and not crowded. The lean is a durability-and-flow read on a near-tie for leadership, not a momentum forecast.
theses.dissent: The margin to the leader is razor-thin and the theme is energy-correlated, so a WTI pullback could hit both leaders simultaneously; this is a cyclical bet dressed as theme rotation.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags XBM.TO by 3% or more while both are positive over the next 20 days

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is the only crowded theme in the eligible set (crowded=true, crowding_z 1.16) with a negative score (-0.21) and mixed trend-health. The crowding flag is a size-down caution, never a sell or fade, so the lean is expressed as avoid rather than underweight. It ranks mid-table on momentum and offers no trend-gate support.
theses.dissent: Technology is the most crowded because investors may know something structural (e.g., an AI or rates narrative) that the rank-IC lens cannot see; avoiding it could mean missing a durable regime shift.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms XBM.TO by 5% or more over the next 20 days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
